name: 焚天炉心
text: 敌方角色身上的[灼烧]不再衰减。
flavor: 焚阳宗的祖炉从未熄过。被它点着的，也不会。

art.subject: a pulsing molten core inside a cracked black iron furnace heart, rivers of fire flowing from its seams

name: 玄武背甲
text: 我方角色的[护甲]在回合开始时不再清零。
flavor: 玄武驮着北方的山。它从不卸下什么。

art.subject: a massive dark tortoise shell plate carved with constellations of the north, a coiled serpent motif around its rim, cold light

name: 万木归根
text: 我方后阵单位具有[远射]。
flavor: 根扎得越深，枝伸得越远。

art.subject: an ancient tree root knot glowing green from within, its tendrils reaching outward like drawn bows, forest dusk

name: 天机星盘
text: 你的延时牌费用-1。每当你打出延时牌，[观星]2。
flavor: 它不预言何时发生，只安排发生的次序。

art.subject: an intricate golden armillary sphere with rotating rings of stars, a tiny comet orbiting inside, deep night sky

name: 鸩羽扇
text: 敌方受到的[中毒]伤害+1。每回合开始时，对随机敌人施加2层[中毒]。
flavor: 扇一下是风，扇两下是命。

art.subject: a folding fan made of dark violet poison-bird feathers, green droplets beading on the tips, held half open

name: 双耳祭鼎
text: 每回合可以献牌为源2次。
flavor: 一耳敬天，一耳敬己。

art.subject: a heavy bronze ritual cauldron with two upright handles, two thin streams of offering smoke rising and glowing

name: 双锋剑匣
text: 你的主帅具有[连斩]（每回合可以武器攻击两次）。
flavor: 匣中两剑，一剑问，一剑答。

art.subject: an open lacquered black sword case holding two identical slender swords side by side, their edges catching red light

name: 雷音铜鼓
text: 友方单位具有[疾行]。
flavor: 鼓一响，没有人等得及。

art.subject: a large bronze war drum with frog figures on its rim, shockwaves of lightning rippling out from the drumhead

name: 离魂灯
text: 每当友方单位入场，使其获得[隐匿]。
flavor: 灯照不到的地方，才是它们的来处。

art.subject: a paper lantern with a cold violet flame, casting no light, faint translucent figures stepping out of its shadow

name: 命书残页·终卷
text: 每回合你打出的第一张牌费用-1。
flavor: 终卷只有一句：先落笔者，定其势。

art.subject: the last torn page of a celestial book, blank except for a single brush stroke glowing gold, floating above an ink stone

name: 不周山石
text: 你的主帅受到的伤害-1。
flavor: 撑过天的石头，挡一刀不算什么。

art.subject: a fist-sized fragment of a broken celestial pillar, dense grey stone veined with faint starlight, resting on silk

name: 金乌衔日
text: 战斗开始时，将一张{sun}日纹13置于天命牌堆顶（仅本场战斗）。
flavor: 第一缕光，是它叼来的。

art.subject: a small three-legged golden crow carved in gold, holding a blazing sun disc in its beak, radiant rays

name: 回音石磬
text: 每回合你第一次在敌方回合打出[应]牌后，重置1枚已用的[源]（可继续作为[余烬]使用）。
flavor: 敲一下，响两声。第二声是留给自己的。

art.subject: an L-shaped black stone chime hanging from a wooden frame, visible sound ripples echoing twice around it

name: 地宫虎符
text: 友方单位+1攻击力。
flavor: 半枚在你手里，另半枚在地下的某位王手里。兵只认符。

art.subject: half of a bronze tiger-shaped military tally inlaid with gold script, the split edge glowing faintly

name: 溺王珠冠
text: 战斗开始时，对所有敌人施加2层[虚弱]和2层[易伤]。
flavor: 戴上它，敌人会看见城沉下去的那一夜。

art.subject: a waterlogged royal pearl crown dripping water, strands of pearls tangled with river weed, dark green depths

name: 剑谱残页
text: 你的主帅获得[连斩]（每回合可攻击两次）。
flavor: 只剩半页，写的是第二剑。

art.subject: a torn yellowed page of a sword manual with ink drawings of a swordsman in two poses, brush annotations, slightly burnt edges

name: 星坠
text: 每回合你第一次进行[判定]后，获得1枚本回合的[源]。
flavor: 坠子是一小块星石，判一次，亮一次。

art.subject: a pendant holding a small fragment of star stone glowing gold, hanging from a fine chain, tiny constellations reflected on it

name: 霜鞘
text: 主帅每次攻击后，获得3点[护甲]。
flavor: 刀收回鞘里的时候，鞘上结了一层霜。

art.subject: a dark scabbard coated in frost with blue cord bindings, a blade half drawn from it showing an icy gleam, snow flakes

name: 砚田
text: 我方回合开始时，获得1层[墨迹]。
flavor: 读书人没有田，砚台就是他的田。

art.subject: a large inkstone carved as terraced rice fields, ink flowing down its terraces like water

name: 祖面
text: 每场战斗第一次[揭面]后，重新戴上同一张[面具]。
flavor: 传了七代的面具，揭下来还会自己回到脸上。

art.subject: an ancient cracked wooden mask with faded gold paint, bound with old red cords and talismans
